description: Forward Claude Code hook events to the local coflux daemon through the cofluxd messenger (silent no-op when cofluxd is not installed); at session start, inside a coflux terminal, print the <coflux-session> block with the session's coflux coordinates; inside a coflux project session, steer `git worktree add|remove|move` to the coflux MCP workspace tools; inside a coflux workspace, deny `Bash(run_in_background: true)` and hand back the equivalent `cofluxd terminal new` so long-running work stays visible in the user's sidebar, and broadcast a `cofluxd progress` line whenever a Bash call still ends up as a background task the user cannot see.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v cofluxd >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec cofluxd hook claude || :'
